services.name: Laser Tag
services.desc: 1 Game has 2 rounds and costs $11.95 per person. Each round lasts 6-8 minutes. Each game can take up to 25 minutes, which includes the rounds and the safety introduction video and fitting laser tag vests on the players. You can play a Free-For-All game where everyone is on their own, or you can play as Teams. Groups can split into two, three, or four teams and are assigned a specific color (red, green, yellow, or blue). There is no height limit or age limit to play.
